instruction: From the workbook open on your desktop, delete any sheets that include percentage change calculations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting sheets that contain percentage change calculations. By examining the data, the Beans, Millet, and Sorghum sheets all have '% changes' columns. The evaluator checks that these three sheets are no longer present in the workbook. Verified by reading the Excel file: Beans (row 2 has 'Gotheye % changes'), Millet (row 1 has 'Gotheye % changes'), and Sorghum (row 1 has 'Gotheye % changes') all contain percentage calculations.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts sheet names from the saved Excel file
Metric logic correctly verifies that specified sheets (Beans, Millet, Sorghum) are absent from the workbook
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Expected values are semantically correct - metadata confirms these three sheets contain percentage change columns
Data flow is correct: getter returns list of current sheets, metric checks deleted sheets are not present
Minor limitation: evaluator doesn't verify that other sheets (without percentage calculations) remain intact, but this is a reasonable design choice for focused verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: Could add verification that at least one non-percentage sheet remains to catch accidental deletion of all sheets
